The Chinese characters for Justin

As a transliteration, Justin is usually written 贾斯廷 (Jiǎ sī tíng). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Origin and meaning

From Latin, Justin carries the meaning “just, righteous”.

About the name Justin

A Roman name meaning 'just', popularised by several early saints.

As a gift or a tattoo

If you are choosing a name for a print or a tattoo, Justin carries the meaning “just, righteous” and looks striking in brush strokes.
